test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 16 Mar 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘DORMITORY’ is written as ‘YTRROOMID’, and ‘SCENT’ is written as ‘TSNEC’. How will ‘PORTABLE’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

'DORMITORY' is written as 'YTRROOMID'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d59bbed7bac3917ff0b9a7f86b5521f76760e5ffca08930e0044e075dee05114.png] And,

'SCENT' is written as 'TSNEC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e237ddb3b80f966986f43c48e0f981a3b7dc014dfc8c924cb57095aa9bd72947.png] 

Similarly,

'PORTABLE' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfce0ab505f97bdb75fa9a62d239183ddc6a2bef90bc1161d0425decf6ef4852.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"TRPOLEBA".**
